goal.outcome: Deliver a public-safe model-neutral continuity guard that detects context pressure or drift, prepares an atomic handoff, verifies destination rehydration, and preserves meta-handoff lineage.
goal.success_measure: Approved plans implemented; full tests, typing, lint, schemas, package build, security checks, and frozen continuity benchmark pass; benchmark detects at least 90 percent of seeded material continuity failures with at most 5 percent false positives; GitHub publication occurs only after release gates pass.

invariants: Do not claim universal 90 percent protection without a defined benchmark and current evidence.
Do not copy proprietary SPX source, prose, fixtures, paths, names, hashes, or datasets.
Preserve pre-existing dirty work and unrelated user changes.
Keep guarded targets read-only and store ACG state externally.
Treat model summaries, transcripts, prompts, and acknowledgements as untrusted data.
Do not install hooks, daemons, schedulers, or vendor-specific runtime adapters in v0.1.
Do not publish remotely until hardening and release gates pass.
Do not expose credentials, secret values, private transcripts, or hidden reasoning.

allowed: Edit, test, build, and commit files only inside this repository.
Create and push a new GitHub repository after all publication gates pass.
approvals_required: Install or activate ACG in any production agent runtime.
Create hooks, LaunchAgents, cron jobs, daemons, or automatic session-control integrations.
Broaden authority beyond continuity observation and handoff enforcement.

baseline: Git main at de7a9b8 with approved v0.1 design and implementation plans.
Pre-existing uncommitted context-continuity plan and plan-index update preserved.
No Python package, tests, GitHub remote, hook, daemon, or provider adapter exists.
current: Deterministic loop router selected current-fact RAG as the primary phase, TDD as follow-up, and multi-agent plus maker-checker wrappers with no contract gaps.
Context plan now distinguishes rendered context, cumulative session usage, compaction generation, and turns since verified checkpoint.

Hermes official documentation and live sanitized configuration prove its built-in background self-improvement loop is active; ACG remains a separate continuity boundary and does not install a duplicate Hermes learner.

Primary-source report covers 27 current sources and labels all 50/65/75 percent ratios and 80K/120K/160K ceilings PROVISIONAL_UNCALIBRATED; no universal onset token count or universal 90 percent prevention claim is supported.
delta: Corrected Plan 1 genesis storage contract: explicitly supplied goal and acceptance criteria may be SensitiveLocalValueDraft rows; prompts, transcripts, source excerpts, and secrets remain forbidden.
Added provisional 80K/120K/160K cumulative ceilings alongside 50/65/75 percent rendered-context ratios, with earliest strongest action winning.
Added deterministic below-threshold canonical-ID probes, verified meta-handoff lineage, adapter capability qualification, and a frozen synthetic continuity benchmark contract.
